verdictRationale:
technicalVerdict is DONE_CURRENT_SHA on exact-current product HEAD 48eefa9dab: the historical repository gates remain recorded below, and a fresh signed production-service journey on the existing real PostgreSQL independently requalified tenant creation, document ingestion, sole run-owned claim approval, immutable snapshot publication, exact Chat binding and process-restart cold reopen (see exactCurrentRuntimeReconciliation20260819). Per AMD-TECHNICAL-DONE-RELEASE-BOUNDARY-002 (20A) that technical completion stands independently of external provider, deployment and release evidence.

Top-level verdict deliberately REMAINS PARTIAL. An earlier revision of this record raised it to DONE_CURRENT_SHA on the reading that VoiceOver was the sole remaining item; an independent audit refuted that reading and it is corrected here rather than left standing. The original open entry bundled four distinct dependencies into one sentence ('Human VoiceOver, brand, named-persona and owner acceptance'), and only ONE of them is waived: AMD-UI-MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE-DEFERRED-002 (19C) places VoiceOver outside MVP scope, but in the same breath DEFERS manual UX and brand acceptance to the pre-release gate and forbids claiming brand approval before that gate. AMD-PERSONA-UAT-SIGNOFF-003 (18C) keeps per-persona signed role journeys required. Note also that 19C's 'Affected tasks' column lists PERSONA-UAT-001, all *-UI-CANON-001, UI-CANON-ALL-001 and REL-001-T01 — ORG-BVP-001 is a *-BVP-001 task and is not named there, so applying the waiver to it at all is the widest defensible reading, not a narrow one. The open list below is therefore itemised per dependency with its own basis instead of being emptied.
open: VoiceOver acceptance: WAIVED as a closure blocker. AMD-UI-MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE-DEFERRED-002 (19C) states VoiceOver acceptance is explicitly outside MVP scope and moves to the post-MVP backlog; it does not block MVP technical DONE.

Manual brand/UX acceptance: STILL OPEN. The same decision 19C DEFERS manual UX and brand acceptance to the pre-release gate and instructs: 'Do not claim manual acceptance, VoiceOver or brand approval before their respective gates.' Deferred is not waived.

Named-persona acceptance: STILL OPEN. AMD-PERSONA-UAT-SIGNOFF-003 (18C) allows one blanket sign-off by the release owner but keeps 'separate automated signed role journeys and forbidden-action controls still required for every persona'; no such per-persona artefact is recorded for this task.
Release/owner boundary (REL-001-T01) is unaffected by this record; per AMD-TECHNICAL-DONE-RELEASE-BOUNDARY-002 (20A) it blocks release, not repository technical completion.
